name: Do I need to turn off the main water supply for a toilet replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to turn off the main water supply for a toilet replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you should turn off the main water supply to your house before beginning a toilet replacement. While there is a shut-off valve behind the toilet itself, turning off the main supply adds an extra layer of precaution and is essential if the toilet's shut-off valve is faulty or needs replacement. This prevents accidental water flow and potential flooding during the removal of the old unit and installation of the new one.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, turn off the main water supply to your house for a toilet replacement. This prevents potential flooding and ensures safety during the process.
